name: Marked
source:
A story of desperation, loneliness and sorrow.

In a world down deep below,
A world made of nothing but stone alone,
Lie prisoners hidden from the land above,
Whose suffering fall on deaf ears.

The story takes place sometime during world war II in an underground prison set in stone. You follow the story of Lexi, a prisoner born in confinement due to her mother being a prisoner during her time of birth.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=28213]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
